name: Hotel Greif „Straudi“
beschreibung: The Hotel Greif „Straudi“ welcomes visitors to the historic alpine town of Landeck in the Tyrolean Oberland. Framed by the peaks of the Lechtal Alps and Samnaun Range, the hotel serves as a friendly and practical hub for hikers, skiers, and transit travelers. Well-appointed guest rooms feature modern furnishings, private facilities, and high-speed Wi-Fi. The in-house restaurant treats patrons to hearty Tyrolean dishes and classic delicacies, delightfully enjoyed outdoors in the garden during summer. A dedicated ski and bike storage room adds convenience, while prime transit connections provide swift access to premier regional ski resorts.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally situated hotel in Landeck with authentic alpine cuisine, beer garden, and ski storage.
